### Dominion Energy South Carolina Recognized for Dedication to Veteran Employees and Their Families


09/10/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 126 KB](https://s205.q4cdn.com/611413639/files/doc_news/2026/09/10/Dominion-Energy-South-Carolina-Recognized-for-Dedication-to-Veteran-Employees-and-Their-Families.pdf)


Dominion Energy employee and military spouse, Mary Sale, gives remarks on her husband’s current deployment and support from the company.
Dominion Energy South Carolina President, Keller Kissam (right), embraces employee and active service member Maurice Hodges (left). Hodges is scheduled to be deployed by the Air Force Air National Guard in 2027.
Dominion Energy South Carolina President, Keller Kissam (left), accepts the Veteran Employer Recognition Program Gold-Level Award from SCDVA Secretary Todd McCaffrey (right).
SCDVA and Dominion Energy, including members of its Veterans Resource Group, celebrate their partnership in support of veterans.


**CAYCE, S.C.** ( **Sept. 10, 2026** ) – Dominion Energy South Carolina has been recognized as a Gold-Level Veteran Employer by the South Carolina Department of Veterans’ Affairs.


The Gold-Level Award honors the company’s longtime commitment to recruiting, hiring and supporting veterans and active service members. The recognition also reflects Dominion Energy’s commitment to military families. One in five new hires at Dominion Energy is a veteran of military service.


Dominion Energy South Carolina President Keller Kissam said the qualities veterans develop through military service are valuable to the company and the communities it serves.


“We hire veterans. Every attribute they have in service to their country is what we desire to have here,” Kissam said. “You show up when you’re needed, you’re on time, you train, you’re disciplined and you put your head on a swivel. You are your brother’s keeper and your sister’s keeper–not just for the employees you work with, but in the communities that we are privileged to serve.”


The SCDVA presented the company with the program’s highest honor during a Sept. 8 ceremony.


“Achieving Gold-Level in the Veteran Employer Recognition Program reflects commitment to and intentional support of veterans,” said Todd McCaffrey, SCDVA Secretary of Veterans' Affairs. “It requires meeting the highest bar we set for how South Carolina employers recruit, empower and support our veterans and their families. Dominion Energy has met that bar and then some. As an industry leader in our state, their dedication sets a powerful example for other employers to follow. We are deeply grateful for their partnership and the critical role they play in helping our veterans build successful careers after service."


For more information on Dominion Energy’s support of veterans and active military, visit[DominionEnergy.com/veterans](https://www.dominionenergy.com/veterans) .


**About Dominion Energy**


Dominion Energy (NYSE:[D](https://investors.dominionenergy.com/home/default.aspx) ), headquartered in Richmond, Va., provides regulated electricity service to[3.6 million](https://www.dominionenergy.com/our-company/operating-segments) homes and businesses in Virginia, North Carolina, and South Carolina, and regulated natural gas service to 500,000 customers in South Carolina. The company is one of the nation’s leading developers and operators of regulated[offshore wind](https://www.dominionenergy.com/projects-and-facilities/wind-power-facilities-and-projects/coastal-virginia-offshore-wind) and[solar](https://www.dominionenergy.com/projects-and-facilities/solar-energy-facilities-and-projects/virginia-solar-projects) power and the[largest producer of carbon-free electricity in New England](https://www.dominionenergy.com/projects-and-facilities/nuclear-facilities/millstone-power-station) . The company’s mission is to provide the[reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy](https://www.dominionenergy.com/our-company) that powers its customers every day. Please visit[DominionEnergy.com](http://www.dominionenergy.com/) to learn more.
